faqs.answer: Open the planner, then use the 3D View button. If the canvas stays blank, refresh the page and ensure the browser allows script execution. The app now includes a safe 3D renderer plus fallback styling.
Use the Log in page with your registered email and password. If you forgot your password, create a new account and then use the same email to access your saved plans.
After designing the layout, enter a project name and click Save Project in the planner. Your plan is stored in the project store and can be opened from the Projects dashboard.
Open a saved project and use the Report option to generate a PDF summary. The report includes plot details, built-up area, and a preliminary estimate for review.

The app is configured for mobile and local network access. Run it on 0.0.0.0, confirm the IP/port, and use the browser on the same network. A manifest and service worker are included for installable behavior.
If MongoDB is unavailable, the app automatically falls back to local JSON stores for auth and project data. You can still use the app while MongoDB is being set up.
